description: This file defines a REST controller in a Spring Boot application with endpoints for greeting, API documentation redirect, health check, and application info.

classes.name: HelloController
classes.description: A REST controller providing basic endpoints such as greeting, documentation redirect, health check, and info for the application.

methods.name: hello
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/' and returns a welcome message.

methods.name: docs
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/docs' and redirects to Swagger UI, constructing the URL based on the incoming request.

methods.name: health
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/health' and returns the application's health status.

methods.name: info
methods.description: Handles GET requests at '/api/info' and returns application information string.
